front_view.description: Id of the body view in which the character faces the viewer.

landmarks.description: Landmark name → observations (see INSTRUCTIONS.md for names).

skin.description: Bare skin regions (face, arms, legs …) — seeds and skin-colour samples.

skin_cleanup.description:
Skin areas whose painted texture must not be baked: hair strands or
garment shadows painted onto skin, stray straps.

skin_cleanup_strokes.description: Thin painted marks on skin (a painted strand or strap) not to bake.

skin_strokes.description: Bands of bare skin too thin for a polygon (a strip between two items).

source_hash.description: `source_hash` from views.json; guidance for another file is refused.

view_sha256.description:
View id → sha256 of the view's PNG when this guidance was started
(copied from the template; leave it unchanged).

layer.description: 0 = worn directly on the skin; outer layers have larger numbers.

strokes.description: Bands along thin parts of the item that a polygon cannot cover.

tight.description: Fits closely (shirt, leggings): the body is allowed to hug it.

oneOf.description:
MakeHuman's head and face rig fitted to the scan; the scan's colour is
baked into MakeHuman's UVs and the eyes are MakeHuman's eyeballs.

Keep the scan's own head (mesh, UVs, texture, painted eyes), rigid to
MakeHuman's `head` bone and lofted onto the MakeHuman neck. Exact face,
no facial rig.

Point.description: One pixel observation of a landmark in a named view.

confidence.description: 1 = clearly visible; lower for joints estimated under clothing.

reason.description: Optional: why the point is here or what hides it.

polygon.description: Pixel vertices, at least three, in order around the region.

Stroke.description: A band along a thin item (strap, moustache, single strand, cord).

points.description: Centre line in pixels, in order along the item (one point = a dot).

width_px.description: Full width of the band in pixels: the item's visible width.

head.description:
Head route for this character: `fit` (MakeHuman head fitted, colour
baked) or `keep_scan` (the scan's own head on the MakeHuman body).
`Config::head`, when set, wins.

kind.description: human, stylized_humanoid, nonhuman (only humanoids are supported).

sex.description: female / male / unknown — which MakeHuman prior fits best.

Visibility.description: How much of a landmark is in view in one observation.

oneOf.description: The spot itself is in view.
Partly hidden (a strand, cuff or strap over part of it).
Hidden (under clothing or hair): placed from proportions.
